items.text: 64 Potassium chloride will have a lower melting point than calcium oxide. The charges on the ions in KCl (K* and Cl-) are lower than in CaO (Ca²+ and O²-). There are weaker electrostatic forces of attraction between oppositely charged ions in KCl than in CaO; these forces require less energy to break than the forces in CaO.
